notes: Only an STO-tier rate card is on file - no separate Rack card was found in this folder, so the % discount this STO figure represents off Rack cannot be verified.

Wide range of unit types: some priced per person per night (cottages, rooms), others per property per night regardless of pax (houses/villas), each with a separate per-person-equivalent All Inclusive figure.
Larger houses have stated minimum pax requirements (see individual entries).

allInclusive_STO_perPersonPerNight.alcoholSupplementNote: All Inclusive excludes an alcohol supplement of US$55pp (local spirits, wine, beer, selected cocktails) - i.e. 'All Inclusive' here still doesn't cover all alcohol without a further charge.

allInclusiveIncludes: Drinks (local wines, beers, spirits) on the farm
Signature Day Trip to Loldaiga, Ol Pejeta, Ngare Ndare, Samburu (min 2 people)
excludes: Transfers (beyond airstrip, for Full Board tier)
All alcoholic drinks and Olepangi signature non-alcoholic drinks (Full Board tier)

US$250 each way (taxi, max 4 pax) or US$350 (4WD, max 8 pax)
